results.title: The Angel in the Death Cell
results.original_title: The Angel in the Death Cell
results.overview: Based on a recently rediscovered play about a Black youth condemned to death by state execution, who is visited by an angel in his prison cell.

results.title: Refusal of The Necropolis
results.overview: A dead man knows nothing of his death; he simply walks through the world, seeing and hearing. Even in his state of alienation, he refuses the idea of ​​dying.

results.title: Somebody wants me dead
results.overview: Haunted by a mysterious voice telling him, “I want you dead,” Happy begins suffering from terrifying disturbances that follow him into the night. As sleepless nights turn into violent encounters and unexplained occurrences, he seeks help from a psychiatrist but soon realizes that whatever is haunting him may be far closer than he imagined.

results.title: Remember That Time
results.overview: In an unprecedented cinematic experiment, five strangers, led by an enigmatic facilitator enter a Nordic LARP (Live Action Role Play), about grief, love, and loss, where the line between performance and reality begins to dissolve.

results.title: Basant Kaur
results.overview: Basant Kaur dreams of representing India in kabaddi, but her life changes after she is sexually assaulted and later betrayed again. Pregnant and traumatized, she survives on the streets until her former classmate Fateh takes her home and cares for her and her newborn child. As Basant recovers her memories, she decides to fight for justice against those who harmed her.

results.title: What we left Unwatered.
results.overview: The members of a Mexican family—María Elena, Doña Aurelia, Doña Elena, and Luisa—are mourning their grandmother and mother, Tita, the matriarch of the household, who, before passing away, passed down to them her recipe for mushroom cream soup, which they used to share regularly as a family dinner. However, over the years, tensions arose among the family members, eventually severing their bonds. Their challenge now is to cook the mushroom cream soup just as Tita used to, while the ingredients and the kitchen come to life and serve as symbols of the family’s disintegration. María Elena struggles to keep her family united and the memory of her Tita alive.

results.title: The Future's Glow
results.overview: On a dark, rainy summer night, the power goes out for a young couple. While looking for a way to light up the room, they discover something strange about their microwave: it is glowing, and its lights reveal the future—but...  Is this the future they desire so much?

results.title: 25 Days
results.overview: Two old friends reunite and start a bond that unravels into something more than just friendship. When one of them has to leave the country for an internship, will their romance last?

results.title: Toen we alles nog wisten
results.overview: When three friends reunite after not having seen each other in years, they find a camera that reveals the truth about what happened the last summer they spent together as a group of five.

results.title: AEW Dynamite : A Tribute to "The Bastard" Pac
results.original_title: AEW Dynamite : A Tribute to "The Bastard" Pac
results.overview: A tribute to Benjamin Satterley, aka PAC, who tragically died this past Sunday. All Elite Wrestling will honor the life, career and legacy of one of the greatest people to ever come into our lives, as so many have done by sharing their stories and memories of such a wonderful, kind human being, who left such an amazing legacy that will never be forgotten.

results.title: Mamu Nikantetau
results.overview: The Mamu Nikantetau expedition, meaning "Let's Move Forward Together" in Innu-aimun, is an annual walk aimed at promoting reconciliation and living together.
